delivery_state: source_ready_for_review; not merged, deployed or accepted

defect.symptom: Root 46039585005 acceptance crawl failed /management/cockpit and /management/persona-fleet on GET /bff/management/persona-fleet 503 after 17,502 ms and 12,579 ms (19:49:00Z and 19:49:28Z). BFF _load_paper_runtime_monitoring_sessions reads GET /api/fleet/state with a 10 s timeout and maps timeouts to PaperReconcilerUnavailableError (503). Sampling GET /readyz inside paper-fleet-reconciler once a second for 90 s at 19:58Z yielded 85 answers in 0.01-0.03 s and slowest five 25.41 s, 14.93 s, 6.42 s, 6.00 s and 5.21 s, with ~40 BrokenPipeError lines in 19:00-20:00Z and healthcheck exit=-1 timeout entries.
defect.root_cause: PaperFleetReconciler.snapshot() (used by /readyz, /healthz, / and /api/fleet/state) acquired self._lock, the same lock reconcile_once() held across its entire admission/transition/worker block (_fetch_source_snapshot HTTP calls to source-ingest at 5 s timeout per symbol, _transition_binding HTTP calls to runtime-manager at 10 s timeout, _start_worker/_terminate_worker subprocess waits up to drain_timeout, and _publish_loop_truth writes).

design_choice_and_rationale.explanation: We perform all network I/O and subprocess waits outside self._lock and apply their resulting state updates atomically under self._lock (publishing self._published_snapshot on every state transition), while serializing reconcile_once() and stop() worker teardown with a dedicated self._cycle_lock.
why_chosen: Composes cleanly with PAPER-RECONCILER-STATE-READ-WITHOUT-CYCLE-LOCK-20261127 (#7987): writers serialize reconcile cycles and stop() teardown on self._cycle_lock, execute all network and subprocess waits outside self._lock, and update in-memory state plus self._published_snapshot atomically under self._lock, while snapshot() and is_ready() read from self._published_snapshot without acquiring either lock.

self._lock is never held across _fetch_fleet_state, _fetch_runtime_summaries, _fetch_source_snapshot, _transition_binding, _publish_loop_truth, leader-store acquire_or_renew/validate/release, _spawn, or process.wait() in _start_worker and _terminate_worker.

Every worker and monitoring-session lifecycle transition is applied in a single with self._lock: critical section and published via self._publish_snapshot(): _start_worker allocates the port and opens the monitoring session under self._lock before _spawn, then registers the WorkerEntry (or records spawn_failed / spawn_fence_lost and ends the session) under self._lock after _spawn and fence validation finish; _terminate_worker (including stale-heartbeat reap) terminates and waits on the subprocess outside self._lock, then ends the monitoring session and removes the WorkerEntry together under self._lock. Readers therefore never observe a running worker with an ended or missing monitoring session, and /readyz computes ready from the same atomic snapshot dict.
self._cycle_lock serializes reconcile_once() and stop() worker teardown so two concurrent reconcile cycles cannot concurrently mutate worker state.
unchanged: Market snapshot admission rules and bootstrap grace period
Pause (active -> pending_pause -> paused) and auto-resume (paused -> active) transitions
Token-fenced leader lease validation before and after worker spawn
Monitoring session start, end, staleness reap and ended-session pruning/persistence

validation.result: Checkout-scoped .venv-pantheon provisioned and verified from a foreign cwd without PYTHONPATH.
117 passed, 2 skipped, 13 subtests passed; all 113 existing reconciler assertions (including TestPublishedFleetSnapshot from #7987) and 4 deterministic concurrency/state-read tests pass.

cases: test_state_reads_return_while_cycle_blocked_in_source_snapshot_fetch: cycle blocked on threading.Event inside _fetch_source_snapshot until explicit release in finally while snapshot(), /api/fleet/state, /readyz and /healthz answer from a bounded reader thread while the writer remains blocked; after the Event is set the next read reflects cycle_count=2 and the newly started worker.

test_state_reads_return_while_cycle_blocked_in_runtime_manager_transition: cycle blocked on threading.Event inside _transition_binding (pending_pause) until explicit release in finally while snapshot(), /api/fleet/state and /readyz return a consistent pre-pause worker/session view from a bounded reader thread while the writer remains blocked; after the Event is set the next read reflects the paused binding, stopped worker and ended monitoring session.

test_state_reads_return_while_cycle_blocked_in_spawn_terminate_and_loop_truth: cycle blocked on threading.Event inside _spawn, loop_writer.record_success and process.wait() during _terminate_worker until explicit release in finally (no self-timing-out mock that _publish_loop_truth could swallow) while state reads in bounded reader threads return without torn worker/monitoring-session views while the writer remains blocked and reflect the updated state after.

test_two_concurrent_cycles_cannot_both_mutate_worker_state: two concurrent reconcile_once() threads are serialized by self._cycle_lock with an explicit _TrackedCycleLock contender/acquisition handshake (no negative sleep timeout) and serialized-region counter lifetime wholly inside _cycle_lock (_fetch_fleet_state entry to _publish_loop_truth exit, max_concurrent_cycles=1, single worker spawned) while HTTP /api/fleet/state and snapshot() still answer from a bounded reader thread without waiting for either cycle.

runtime_budget.cadence: Unchanged: RECONCILER_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS default 15 s; RECONCILER_LOOP_WRITE_INTERVAL_SECONDS default 30 s.
runtime_budget.timeouts_and_owner_calls_per_cycle: Unchanged: same runtime-manager desired-state and transition calls (10 s timeout), telemetry runtime-summaries call (10 s timeout), source-ingest latest snapshot calls (5 s timeout), and worker drain timeout (10 s default).
runtime_budget.cap_and_cleanup: Unchanged: monitoring session persistence retains at most 20 ended sessions and retired binding state files are unlinked when nothing is pending.

required_read_only_probes_after_deploy: Sample GET /readyz inside the paper-fleet-reconciler container once a second for 90 s and report the slowest five response times.
Count BrokenPipeError lines in the paper-fleet-reconciler container log per hour for one hour (baseline 19:00-20:00Z on 2026-11-27 had ~40) and inspect container healthcheck log for exit=-1 entries.
Run GET /bff/management/persona-fleet as admin three times and record status codes and elapsed seconds.
Verify the next Dev Root acceptance crawl passes /management/persona-fleet and /management/cockpit or names a different failed read.
